you_should_know.title: Alleged gang members say they'll stay away from Minnesota State Fair this year
you_should_know.summary: Between a judge's order and voluntary agreements, the State of Minnesota and Ramsey County, the county that covers St. Paul, just east of Minneapolis, achieved legal blockades against 10 people accused of planning gang violence at the Minnesota State Fair, after years of gang fights and gunfire have caused chaos at the fairgrounds.

you_should_know.title: Hundreds of union jobs or a threat to the Boundary Waters? Twin Metals mine divides northern Minnesota
you_should_know.summary: Twin Metals says a copper-nickel mine near the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness, lake country on the Canadian border roughly 250 miles north of Minneapolis, would bring hundreds of union jobs and 1,400 additional positions. Still, opponents say the environmental risks to the watershed are not worth the trade-offs.
